notes: Restart from the true baseline: 90.8 kg and 28.5% body fat (11 Sep). Goal 0.5% a week, about 0.45 kg. Ten weeks lands near 86–87 kg and 25% if you hold it. Rules. 1) Three gym days: Sat, Mon, Wed. Two is a pass. Never make up a session. 2) One balanced plan, same food every day. Weigh cooked food and tick every meal every day, including bad days. Logging stopped after 5 Oct, and that was the first sign. 3) Cardio is planned: 15 minutes of easy incline walking after each lift. Nothing else counts. Daily steps stay around 2,000 because you only go home, work, and the gym. 4) Sleep 7 hours or more. 5) One planned flex meal a week, Friday dinner only. Not a day, not a weekend. 6) Craving at night: water, coffee, or Coke Zero, then wait 20 minutes. If still hungry, eat the next planned meal early; do not add extra food. 7) Weigh every morning; judge the 7-day average, not the day. 8) Week 5 and week 9 are reset weeks: 2 sets per exercise, plus 100 g cooked rice at dinner and one extra small banana daily. 9) If the 7-day average falls less than 0.25 kg a week for 2 weeks in a row after week 3, add one 30-minute easy cardio visit on Thursday. Only if that is not enough, cut dinner rice from 40 g to 0. 10) If energy is 2 out of 5 or lower, or hunger is 4 out of 5 or higher, on 3 days in one week, take a reset week early instead of skipping sessions.

diet.name: Restart — one balanced plan every day, about 1,830 kcal
diet.notes: Egyptian labels. One plan, same food every day, no carb cycling. Food only: 1831 kcal, protein 183 g, carbs 157 g, fat 47 g (about 40% protein, 35% carbs, 25% fat). Two Nescafé with 80 ml Juhayna skim each sit outside this total (about 95 kcal). Coke Zero is allowed; one Red Bull Zero on gym days only. Weeks 3–4 ran 1,660 / 1,497 kcal and ended in low energy, cravings, and a week off. This is higher on purpose, and it is the same on gym days and rest days. Do not cut below it. Friday dinner may be replaced by one planned flex meal, up to about 900 kcal, protein first, one plate, no leftovers. It is not a day and not a weekend. Week 5 and week 9 reset weeks: add basmati rice 100 g cooked to dinner and one extra small banana, every day.

training.name: 3-day full body (Sat / Mon / Wed)
training.notes: Three evenings: Saturday, Monday, Wednesday. Sun, Tue, Thu, Fri are rest. A week with 2 sessions is a pass. A week with 3 is a good week. Never make up a missed session and never stack two sessions in a day. If Saturday is missed, Monday is the first session. If two sessions are missed in one week, do not change the plan; just do the next scheduled session. Every session is about 18–19 sets, 60 minutes of lifting plus the 15-minute walk. Stop every set with 1–2 reps in the tank. Hold the load until every set reaches the top of the rep range, then add 2.5–5 kg. Week 1 is a re-entry week after the break: 3 sets on the big lifts at the lighter weights written in the notes. Week 5 is a light week: 2 sets per exercise, same weights. Week 9 is a light week as well. Cardio is planned, not left to chance: 15 minutes of easy incline walking after each lift, 3 times a week. You only walk between home, work, and the gym, so daily steps stay around 2,000 and are not part of the plan. If the 7-day average stalls after week 3, the first lever is one extra 30-minute easy cardio visit on Thursday, before any food is cut.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
